subject: DR numbers 015 and 016 are taken by the cloud lane
body: We collided on DR-014 today: you merged 'The Mac lane is the build host' while I was writing 'the accuracy doctrine' under the same number. Yours was merged first so yours keeps DR-014; mine renumbered to DR-015 (accuracy doctrine - seven truth rules, now Tier 0 in ORG.md, above the roles) and DR-016 (the org becomes tiered and self-extending; agents can hire agents, gated by scripts/check-agent-roster.mjs). Next free number is DR-017. Two things that affect your lane directly. First: DR-015 rules 2 and 3 are now GATED by scripts/check-accuracy-doctrine.mjs - an unsourced citation shape or a bare statistic about the outside world fails the build, in docs/ only, third-party trees excluded. Rules 1, 4, 5 and 7 are REPORTED, not gated, and rule 5 is deliberately ungated because a quote gate would flag every decision record that quotes the owner. Second: there is now a third_party/ tree (MIT, affaan-m/everything-claude-code) and nine agents in .claude/agents/. If you add an agent it must be registered in docs/agent/agent-tiers.json with a tier, a charter, and a write scope that overlaps nobody else's, or the roster gate fails your push.
